projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota 9 MW HPC facility
projects.quote: We are in the process of constructing a 9 megawatt (“MW”) facility next to the Company’s currently operating 100-MW hosting facility in Jamestown, North Dakota.

projects.name: AI Cloud services GPU commitment
projects.quote: In June, the Company expanded its commitment for up to 26,000 GPUs for the Company's AI Cloud services business.

projects.name: AI Cloud initial production cluster
projects.quote: The Company has received and deployed an initial production cluster of 1,024 GPUs.

projects.name: Jamestown hosting facility
projects.quote: As of May 31, 2023, the facility had approximately 105 MW of capacity, which is fully contracted with our customers.

projects.name: Garden City Facility
projects.quote: This facility is collocated with a wind farm and upon completion is expected to provide 200 MW of power to hosting customers.

projects.name: Ellendale hosting facility
projects.quote: The facility is fully energized and the facility will have approximately 180 MW of capacity, which is fully contracted with our customers
